scope: Relative source-grounded local preferences over the same actual inputs, not perfect global states. Observed model responses remain unchanged; only equivalent format conversion is used. Counterfactual no-change/duplicate-copy alternatives are explicitly synthetic, not observed model outcomes.

observed_negatives.innovation-harbor-transition-1-reference: Invents an end-of-day expiry for a cancellation and leaves the invalidated support route.
observed_negatives.innovation-harbor-transition-2-reference: Asserts an unsupported history-versus-change distinction and leaves the old expiry/positive dependency problem.
observed_negatives.innovation-orchid-transition-1-reference: Overwrites the before-effective-date assignment instead of retaining both periods.
observed_negatives.innovation-catalog-transition-1-referenc: Attaches per-member quantity semantics to a book editor correction.
observed_negatives.innovation-grant-transition-3-reference: Duplicates the membership event in a new record and existing record, and generalizes this one event into a permanent rule.
observed_negatives.innovation-shared-transition-3-reference: Omits the new West scope, rewrites old scope, misattributes reports as observed, and uses failed ventilation as a positive premise.
observed_negatives.innovation-studio-transition-3-reference: No operation omits the new independent sticker information.
observed_negatives.innovation-catalog-formation-reference-v: Adds per-member quantity metadata to editors and cover color.
observed_negatives.innovation-shared-formation-reference-v3: Combines independently changeable equipment states and misattributes the user report as observed; absence of a graph alone is not the negative label.

counterfactuals: Required edits versus a no-change action; valid no-change references versus an unnecessary semantic copy of the current source. References themselves remain author-reviewed development data.
